allowed_shims.reason: zero-consumer compatibility shim that VLT-GAP-06-D requires to stay a re-export-only file; GAP-14/15 configs also name it

security_primitive_allow.reason: snapshot file-format KDF (AYZENBAK1/2): password + random per-file salt, v1/v2 cost params fixed by the exported-file format; not shared with any other scrypt use
seed-phrase key derivation from VAULT_SEED_ENCRYPTION_KEY with the fixed legacy salt that already-stored seed phrases depend on
outbound webhook signature (X-Ayzen-Signature); the only signer in the Vault tree

route_scope_exclusions.reason: marketplace commerce routes (marketplace.ts, cart, coupons, offers, wallet, …) are not Vault behaviour; Vault-owned marketplace routes are marketplace-game and marketplace-vault. Known and out of scope: marketplace.ts GET /marketplace/vault-items is a read-only listing query on vault_entries/local_accounts that exists nowhere else, and routes/search.ts, sync.ts, projects.ts, two-factor.ts and services/sync.ts also read vault_entries directly (cross-domain read models, not copies of extracted Vault code)
